title: Kingman crash was 'the one they walked away from'

tellings.quote: So this girl that I I have contact with was sitting right near one of the main people. I say who it is, but one of the main people. And as that came up, he said, "That's not right. That's not right. That was that crash. That's the one they walked away from."

plain: A UFO crash said to have happened near Kingman, Arizona, was 'the one they walked away from', according to a remark by an insider at a showing of the documentary maker James Fox's film at the SOL conference, a UFO research gathering. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells it from a woman he is in contact with, who was sitting next to one of the main people there, a man Cameron won't name; when the Kingman crash came up on screen, the man said, 'That's not right. That's not right. That was that crash.' If true, it would mean someone with inside knowledge holds a different version of that crash than the one shown.
